column1: # phi-delegate pattern source. Read by scripts/phi-scan.sh (grep -E / sed -E)
# and by the mod (hooks/scan.ts, via the generated hooks/patterns.generated.ts).
# Run scripts/gen-mod-data.sh after editing; bats fails on drift.
# Columns are tab separated, and an empty field is written "-":
#   kind   class: a scan class, reported in this order
#          mask: rewritten before scanning (infrastructure ids, GitHub
#                URLs, and timestamps, which are not PHI). A timestamp is a
#                date in 2000 or later with a time other than midnight: a
#                date of birth stored as a datetime prints as midnight, and
#          drop: line dropped under --profile diff (git metadata), only
#                outside a hunk; every line inside a hunk is content
#          hunk: "start" and "end" mark a hunk for --profile diff: it runs
#                from an @@ (or a merge diff's @@@) line to the next diff
#   name   the class or rule name
#   tags   comma list: identifier (value-shaped, scanned in prompts by
#          default), keyword (opt-in for prompts), prose-skip (skipped by
#   regex  POSIX extended regex, also valid JavaScript (and awk, for hunk
#          rows); no "#" in mask rows; drop rows start with ^
#   repl   mask rows only: the replacement, \1 for the first group
